nodes.text: Phở Bình là một nhà hàng ở Đường Lý Chính Thắng, Phường Xuân Hòa, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh.

Món ghi nhận: vietnamese. This was the secret headquarters of the Viet Cong (Vietnamese Communists; VC) in Saigon and from here they planned their attacks on the US embassy and other Saigon targets during the Tet Offensive of 1968. (Mini Museum upstairs)
